mhp-vinnytsia-poultry.conditions_add: IFC's 2010 investment agreement with MHP included an Environmental and Social Action Plan with items on environmental, health and safety management and monitoring and on grievance systems for workers and communities. For the 2014 loan, IFC required an independent audit of MHP's workplace safety and a traffic management plan as part of the project action plan (IFC response in CAO, Compliance Appraisal Report, 2025).

why.safeguard: IFC required an independent audit of MHP's workplace safety and a traffic management plan

alto-maipo.conditions_add: Before approving finance, the lenders including IFC set eight 'Critical Path Gaps' that Alto Maipo was expected to address as a condition for financing approval, and required an Advanced Sediment Transport Study; an Environmental and Social Action Plan then set requirements for the company to meet the lenders' standards, including a further study of impacts on recreational river use (CAO, Compliance Investigation Report, 2021). The IDB's action plan also required the company to prepare a plan for the impacts of workers moving into the area (MICI, Compliance Review Report, 2020).

why.safeguard: eight 'Critical Path Gaps' that Alto Maipo was expected to address as a condition for financing approval

why.safeguard: to agree an action plan with the developer as a condition of the additional financing

why.safeguard: confirmed as part of the investment agreement, had 11 actions

titan-egypt-cement.conditions_add: In the March 2010 investment agreements the company committed to apply IFC's Performance Standards. The action plan agreed in November 2009 required extra controls at the Alexandria plant to cut average dust (particulate) emissions to 100 mg/Nm3 or less within 24 months of disbursement and yearly air-quality monitoring reported to IFC; the agreement also had provisions on the plants' licences, which the company asked IFC to waive in August 2010 (CAO, Compliance Investigation Report).

why.safeguard: required extra controls at the Alexandria plant to cut average dust (particulate) emissions to 100 mg/Nm3 or less within 24 months of disbursement

why.safeguard: included IFC requirements for a water quality monitoring programme following WHO school standards

mai-ndombe-redd.conditions_add: The Emission Reductions Payment Agreement signed in September 2018 had six conditions of effectiveness, including a final Benefit Sharing Plan, an action plan for handling reversals, an action plan on transferring title to the emission reductions, and evidence that DRC had secured US$2.2 million to run the programme; all six were met by July 2022. A legal covenant also required DRC to revise the programme's reference level, which was cut from 48.0 to 33.0 million tonnes of CO2 a year (World Bank, Implementation Status and Results Report and Restructuring Paper, P160320).

why.safeguard: had six conditions of effectiveness, including a final Benefit Sharing Plan
